action.summary: Delete `UnusedTotal` from dead_export/dead_export.go if nothing outside the repository uses it, or import dead_export/dead_export.go where `UnusedTotal` is meant to be called.

findings.detail: No import in the repository resolves to dead_export/dead_export.go or another file of its module, and nothing in it is an entry point, test, or framework hook. If `UnusedTotal` is part of a library's public API this is expected; in an application it is dead, along with whatever only it calls.
findings.title: `deadexport.UnusedTotal` is exported but no import resolves to dead_export/dead_export.go

action.summary: Delete `forgottenRate` from dead_helpers/dead_helpers.go if nothing outside the repository uses it, or import dead_helpers/dead_helpers.go where `forgottenRate` is meant to be called.

findings.detail: No import in the repository resolves to dead_helpers/dead_helpers.go or another file of its module, and nothing in it is an entry point, test, framework hook, or export, so no root reaches `forgottenRate`. Cupel sees imports between files, not calls, so this holds for the whole file; module-level code, a script run directly, or loading by computed name (reflection, `getattr`, string-keyed registries, dynamic imports) could still reach it.
findings.title: `deadhelpers.forgottenRate` is unreachable: no import resolves to dead_helpers/dead_helpers.go
